showcase.title: U5 World and HPA Route Showcase
showcase.playerPerspective: Use Show HPA Chunks. The player-facing route review must show the 64km world, active data window, start/goal chunks, numbered crossed chunks, and portal crossings.
showcase.modAuthorPerspective: HPA is the macro route contract; inspect chunk IDs and portal crossings before judging any low-level NavMesh path or unit movement.
